spider-climb.gist: A willing creature walks on walls and ceilings with a Climb Speed

spike-growth.gist: 20-foot-radius Difficult Terrain: 2d4 Piercing damage per 5 feet moved

spirit-guardians.gist: Foes in a 15-foot Emanation move at half Speed; Wisdom save or 3d8 damage

spiritual-weapon.gist: Floating weapon makes melee spell attacks for 1d8 + modifier Force damage

starry-wisp.gist: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 Radiant damage and the target can't be Invisible

stinking-cloud.gist: 20-foot-radius gas: Constitution save or Poisoned and no action or Bonus Action

stone-shape.gist: Reshape a Medium stone object or 5-foot section of stone into any form

stoneskin.gist: A willing creature gains Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage

storm-of-vengeance.gist: A 300-foot-radius storm cloud strikes with thunder, acid, lightning and hail over turns

suggestion.gist: Wisdom save or Charmed and follows a reasonable suggestion of up to 25 words

summon-dragon.gist: Summons a Draconic Spirit ally that acts right after you

sunbeam.gist: 60-foot Line: Con save or 6d8 Radiant damage and Blinded; recast as a Magic action

sunburst.gist: 60-foot-radius Sphere: Constitution save or 12d6 Radiant damage and Blinded

symbol.gist: Inscribe a hidden glyph that triggers a harmful effect such as Death or Fear

tashas-hideous-laughter.gist: Wisdom save or Prone and Incapacitated, laughing uncontrollably

telekinesis.gist: Move a creature (Strength save) or an object up to 30 feet with your mind

teleport.gist: Teleports you and up to eight willing creatures to a known destination

teleportation-circle.gist: Opens a portal to a permanent teleportation circle whose sigils you know

tensers-floating-disk.gist: A floating disk of force carries up to 500 pounds and follows you

thaumaturgy.gist: Creates a minor wonder, such as a booming voice, flickering flames or a phantom sound

thunderwave.gist: 15-foot Cube: Constitution save or 2d8 Thunder damage and pushed 10 feet

time-stop.gist: Time stops for others while you take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row

tongues.gist: A touched creature understands any language and is understood by all

transport-via-plants.gist: Links a Large plant to a distant one; creatures step through between them

tree-stride.gist: Step into a tree and out of another of the same kind within 500 feet

true-polymorph.gist: Turns a creature or object into another creature or object; Wisdom save resists

true-resurrection.gist: Revives a creature dead up to 200 years with all HP, even with a new body

true-seeing.gist: A willing creature gains Truesight out to 120 feet

true-strike.gist: Weapon attack using your spellcasting ability; damage can be Radiant

tsunami.gist: A moving wall of water: Strength save or 6d10 Bludgeoning damage, half on a success

unseen-servant.gist: An invisible force performs simple tasks at your command

vampiric-touch.gist: Melee spell attack: 3d6 Necrotic damage, and you heal half the damage

vicious-mockery.gist: Wisdom save or 1d6 Psychic damage and Disadvantage on its next attack

vitriolic-sphere.gist: 20-foot-radius Sphere: Dexterity save or 10d4 Acid damage, then 5d4 more

wall-of-fire.gist: A wall of fire: Dexterity save or 5d8 Fire damage; one side burns nearby creatures

wall-of-force.gist: Creates an invisible, indestructible wall of force that nothing passes

wall-of-ice.gist: A wall of ice: Dexterity save or 10d6 Cold damage for those it cuts through

wall-of-stone.gist: Creates a nonmagical wall of stone made of ten 10-foot panels

wall-of-thorns.gist: A wall of thorns: Dexterity save or 7d8 Piercing damage; slow and painful to cross

warding-bond.gist: Ally gets +1 AC and saves and Resistance to all damage; you take the same damage

water-breathing.gist: Up to ten willing creatures can breathe underwater

water-walk.gist: Up to ten willing creatures walk on water and other liquids as solid ground

web.gist: Sticky webs fill a 20-foot Cube: Difficult Terrain, Dexterity save or Restrained

weird.gist: Chosen creatures: Wisdom save or 10d10 Psychic damage and Frightened

wind-walk.gist: You and up to ten creatures become clouds with a 300-foot Fly Speed

wind-wall.gist: A wall of wind: Strength save or 4d8 Bludgeoning damage; it deflects arrows

wish.gist: Duplicate any spell of level 8 or lower, or alter reality itself

word-of-recall.gist: You and up to five willing creatures teleport to your prepared sanctuary

zone-of-truth.gist: Creatures in a 15-foot-radius Sphere that fail a Charisma save can't lie
